youtube.title: Every Hair on You Is Scheduled to Fall Out | Skin Sense No. 017
youtube.caption:
Series: Season 1: The organ you live inside, part 17 of 6.

Sources
1. Each hair follicle cycles through growth, regression, rest and shedding. — NCBI (NIH): https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470321/
2. Scalp hair anagen lasts about 2 to 6-7 years, which sets how long it can grow. — statpearls.com: https://statpearls.com/sp/al/13/22483/
3. In catagen the lower follicle regresses; the club hair rests in telogen for about 100 days. — NCBI (NIH): https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK499948/
4. A new anagen hair grows beneath the resting club hair and pushes it out. — NCBI (NIH): https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482293/
5. Shedding about 50-100 scalp hairs a day is normal. — statpearls.com: https://statpearls.com/sp/al/13/22482/

Illustrations: AI-generated and 3-D animation made in code, no stock footage. Narration: a real person's voice (recorded, not AI). Cover illustration made with AI. Every number is checked against the sources.

Skin Sense: Skin biology, ingredients and routines, with the evidence on the screen.
